clips.title: Most Replayed Moment: Christian vs Atheist - Is Faith A Human Creation?
clips.speaker: The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett
clips.why: Живая речь, фрагмент с 11:11 выпуска, темп около 237 слов в минуту.
clips.transcript: If anybody thinks that the four of us sat at this table are going to solve the meaning crisis and give people a five step guide finding meaning in their life, and that will be the sort of case closed, then they're delusional. I don't know if I agree that we can't find an answer, but we'll talk about this. Well, this is what I wanted to speak to it. If obviously we're talking about this broader issue of meaning and purpose. All right. And as I mentioned earlier, there either is an objective one or it's only subjective. OK, if it is an objective one, this is about the most important thing that anyone could ever find out about their life if they were created for a reason. In my view, the reason I'm here is because I'm convinced that that's the case and willing to give reasons why.
